description: Phase 3 documentation: README with setup, usage, RAG pipeline explanation, SSE events, testing, and deployment notes
steps: 1. Create docs/PHASE3-README.md with comprehensive documentation covering: what was implemented (RAG pipeline overview), how the pipeline works (document upload -> load -> chunk -> embed -> store in Qdrant -> retrieval at chat time), how to upload knowledge documents (API + UI), how to use KB in chat (kb_document_ids field + UI toggle), SSE citation event format, how to run tests, deployment notes (Qdrant setup, fastembed model download on first run, environment variables: QDRANT_URL).
2. Include a text-based diagram of the RAG pipeline flow in the documentation.
3. Document all new API endpoints with request/response examples.
4. Document environment variables and configuration needed for Phase 3.
5. Add troubleshooting section for common issues (Qdrant connection, model download, large PDF handling).
acceptance_criteria: All new API endpoints are documented with examples
Setup and deployment instructions are clear
